name: Asanami Kou
source:
Chemistry Teacher and Science Club Adviser.
He's supposed to be the advisor to the science club, but he's usually just making plastic models in the club room. 
A free spirit, he only speaks out to prevent huge problems.
He has a much younger little brother, [url=/c29871]Shou[/url].
